Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 0
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator’s initial plan misassigned the task to FileSurfer to “listen” to and transcribe the audio despite known transcription failure and FileSurfer’s limitations. It then repeatedly looped through similar instructions and web-based workarounds instead of leveraging ComputerTerminal to run a local transcription (e.g., Whisper) on the MP3. This misplanning prevented obtaining the correct page numbers and led to an arbitrary, incorrect final answer.
